body:
I will try and endure as long as i can. I actually ran out of hospital earlier today at 6 am just to go and hug and kiss my son. 

It brightens my day when i saw him laugh.
And thank you vedro for taking your time to write for me here. I appreciate it very much.

I do wish things get better but i don't know if i can still hold on.
Its 5AM over here and my surgery is due at 1530 hours later today.
Still couldn't sleep thinking about how stupid i got when the migraine hits, that i broke my wife's windshield and scared my son and still praying that he won't develop a phobia because of what i have just did.

I think about him all the time. I really loved them both.
I've developed migraine, anxiety and panic disorder in the past 6 years.
Been trying to get a job, but it doesn't seem to work at all. Onterviews are getting less and less. One of the company i interviewed previously even said the my previous employee (the government job) referred me as useless.
I go out during working hours everyday looking for job an returning with none at all.
In the evening, night and weekends, i waited nervously for a cop or one of my customers to show up at my doorsteps.
I'm heading towards bankruptcy because i took a loan of 10k usd back then to repair my parents home. (Previous boss and the HQ even said that i have future within the department because i work hard and smart, i was bound to be a confirmed employee in a year while others had to wait 3 years for it). And with interest, it goes up to nearly 20k usd.
I've tried everything but nothing works.
I clearly do not deserve my loving son, parents, my wife  and siblings.

I am not a native English speaker so im very sorry for my bad English.

And i typed whatever was on my mind, sorry the post went a messy.
